name: Kabbalah
overview: Scripture reveals that God alone is the ultimate source of all creation and knowledge, as seen in His self-identification as 'I AM' and His role as Creator of heaven and earth. While God has revealed certain truths for us to follow, there remain secret things that belong solely to Him, emphasizing the limits of human understanding. Wisdom and understanding are blessings to be sought, yet the depths of God's purposes are beyond full human discovery, highlighting both the honor in seeking knowledge and the necessity of trusting God's revealed word.
